The artefact directory is `./artifact-C` (not `./artifact`). Findings below; also written to `findings.json`.

**Examined:** all 14 bundled files in full — `SKILL.md` (7 steps, 3 rules, When-to-use, In-this-repo), `references/rationale.md`, `evals.md` (S1–S6), `evals/evals.json` (3 evals, 23 expectation strings), the real grader `evals/files/check.py` (63 lines), the 3-note wiki fixture with INDEX/LOG/SOURCES, and the 3 raw sources. Pair classes swept: step→rule (21), step→step (21 ordered, plus branch reachability from step 2's four dispositions), step→eval check, evals.md→evals.json→check.py per executed chain, description→body, body→rationale, files→BOM, and fixture-state→rule. I also re-executed three of check.py's predicates against the untouched fixture and resolved its T3 fixture path against the eval prompt's wiki path.
